owner_accepted_network_exposure.scope: Unpaired clients on the shared Cart Wi-Fi may access Matrix/AUX WLED JSON HTTP APIs without authentication.
consequences: Raw WLED API requests bypass Owner/Guest PWA visibility and command constraints.
Clients may directly set supported device state and effects, including firmware-supported UV outputs, subject to device firmware behavior.
The Owner gateway's authentication applies only to requests sent through its HTTPS endpoints and does not protect direct WLED requests.
owner_accepted_network_exposure.access_boundary: No network or router change is included in this package.

scope: existing Opal Nginx authenticated local proxy
authenticated local UV routes with fixed segments, AUX readback, and shared default-off hardware-profile/commissioning-gate enforcement
separate per-command HTTPS transport for the existing Owner PWA
no firmware installation, backend deployment, scoring, or live router changes
